title: Widen the bagel hole without thinning one side
instruction: Shape the prepared bagel ring with an even open centre and leave it on the greased sheet.
context: Home bagel shaping leaves a large open centre before boiling and baking. The recipe calls for a 1.5–2 inch opening. The manipulation tested is distributing permanent deformation around a cohesive food ring while keeping its narrowest wall intact, judged after unloading. Familiarity with eating bagels alone does not establish familiarity with making them.
